page.overview:
Who is Splash and Splatter?

Splash and Splatter are two newkama pirate twins. They both willingly donated blood to Sanji when he was dying of severe blood loss.

Being twins, Splash and Splatter look almost exactly the same. They are both muscular and have exaggerated male facial features, which are covered with excessive make-up. They have spiked eyebrows and long spiked hair. They wear the Criminal brand and are almost always flexing.

The key differences between them is that Splash has brown hair and wears a pink shirt, with light pink edges and a yellow star on the chest, and black tights, while Splatter has blond hair and wears a white shirt, with blue edges and a red star on the chest, and black tights. In Gigant Battle 2, they wear purple and yellow.

Splash and Splatter both act very effeminate and brag about their physiques by showing off their muscles. They are kind-hearted individuals as they willingly donated their blood to save a fellow human life. They end all of their sentences with the word , followed by a heart, showing the "feminine tone" being used in speech.
